result_preview.description: This data product consolidates safety compliance records, incident history, and behavioral risk indicators to evaluate workforce safety posture and organizational hazard mitigation effectiveness. Delivers metrics on safety incident clustering, compliance adherence trajectories, and high-risk employee segments to inform occupational health strategies, preventive interventions, and regulatory compliance initiatives across the enterprise.
